messages:
mia: FYI I'm kicking off a quick preflight for the new org/account bundle we'll provision across AWS and GCP tomorrow. Putting the checklist here so we can run through gaps before the request window opens.

sam: thanks — can you drop target quota numbers? also region preferences?

mia: top-level goals: (1) enough GPU headroom for initial pilot (2) egress & NAT IPs reserved for telemetry and model pulls (3) IAM/billing/tags set for cost tracking. Prefer us-west-2 + europe-west1 for pilot.

nora: for GPUs let's request conservative numbers first to avoid rejections, then scale: on AWS request 8 x p4d (or p4de) capacity and 32 x g5s as burst. on GCP request 16 x a2 and 64 x t4 preemptible quota. note regional availability varies.

pj: +1 on regional availability note. also ask for quota increase for "Regional External IP" / EGRESS bandwidth per project — we've hit limits in previous orgs. Recommend requesting 100 static EIPs in region and 10 Gbps soft limit increase for egress per project.

mia: adding the concrete items I plan to put in support tickets:
```
AWS (us-west-2):
- EC2 On-Demand / Spot GPU instances: p4d.24xlarge: 8 (initial), g5.12xlarge: 32 (burst)
- ENIs / Dedicated IP spare: 100
- VPC Egress (NAT gateway throughput advisory): request guidance for >5Gbps sustained
- Service Quotas: EBS gp3 IOPS baseline increase where needed

GCP (europe-west1):
- GPU quota: A100-80GB: 4, A100-40GB/A2: 12, T4 (preemptible): 64
- External NAT IPs: 100
- VPC egress quota bump: 10Gbps
- IAM: custom role template for infra agents
```

nora: looks good. for AWS sometimes they require project-level justification per dev/test vs prod. include: "model training/inference pilot, latency-sensitive inference endpoints, cost-aware autoscaling test". also attach sample monthly vCPU/GPU spend estimates.

sam: can we add a small note about quotas that impact the runtime: KV cache sizes, instance metadata limits? earlier we had throttling on metadata server when we launched thousands of small workers.

mia: good call. will add: "metadata requests: ensure instance metadata service quotas or overall request throttles are noted; if possible request soft-limit increase or guidance."

pj: tagging policy reminder: required tags = {cost_center, product_team, env, region, owner}. We should predefine tag values and include terraform snippet so provisioning scripts set them.

mia: adding snippet for tags to ticket:
```
Tags / Labels (example):
- cost_center: RL-PLATFORM
- product_team: inference-runtime
- env: pilot
- region: us-west-2
- owner: infra-oncall@redwood.com
```

infra-bot: deploy-checklist reminder: run `./scripts/preflight-cloud-checks.sh --org new-org --regions us-west-2,europe-west1` once quotas are approved.

nora: one more ops note — ask cloud support to enable placement group capacity reservations (for low-latency collocated GPUs) or guidance on AZ-level shortages. saves us a ton of rework.

sam: on cost side, request committed use discounts guidance for pilot — don't commit until we have stable utilization, but include a forecast table so finance can evaluate.

mia: final action items: (1) I'll open AWS & GCP support tickets with the above payload and attach justification + spend forecast (2) pj please draft terraform tag module and sample IAM role (3) sam, can you generate the 3-month pilot spend forecast by EOD? (4) nora, can you pre-run the preflight script in staging and paste output here?

pj: on it. drafting tag module now.

sam: will have spend numbers by 17:00 PST.

nora: starting preflight run now, will paste any blockers.

mia: thanks all. I'll ping once tickets are submitted and add the ticket IDs here (:thumbsup:).
